title: Sigvor's Cheese
offer: My goats gave so much milk this summer! I made four big wheels of cheese for Orm's autumn feast in Hallvik, but my boat is full of goats. Will you carry them?

steps.load_say: Roll them in gently. And no nibbling!
steps.say: Sigvor's cheese! The guests will fight over it. Well, not fight: they will ask nicely.

fact: Cheese keeps the milk of the summer for the winter.
